checkpoint_law: L0 APK accepted; L1 runtime executes; L2 lifecycle; L3 view tree; L4 rendering; L5 input; L6 state changes; L7 multi-feature interaction; V visual evidence. Telegram/WhatsApp are honest BLOCKED load frontiers — their frames are NOT renders.

fields.nx: first failing checkpoint (WHERE exactly the problem is)
fields.n: evidence-backed note: WHY it fails / what was observed
fields.ev: evidence pointer (paths/issues) — raw logs are NEVER in git
fields.next: WHAT to do next (derived from nx + status)

laws: one line per app — grep-able, token-minimal onboarding
raw logs and APKs are NEVER committed (see .gitignore + #386)
canonical data stays in canonical/ — this is the triage projection
every claim must carry an evidence pointer
